acceptance.requirement: Remote repository, main SHA, tree, and predecessor CI match a recorded entry receipt.
acceptance.evidence: decision authority, source-bound manifest, and verified predecessor runs
acceptance.failure_condition: entry authority cannot be independently resolved or differs from the frozen checkpoint

acceptance.requirement: The branch starts from the verified Stage 2 completion checkpoint and contains only EventPulse work.
acceptance.failure_condition: base ancestry, base tree, or changed-file scope differs

acceptance.requirement: Draft PR #1 remains separate and no AWS operation is executed.
acceptance.evidence: decision authority, PR-state recheck, and no-AWS execution record
acceptance.failure_condition: draft PR #1 changes, enters authority, or any AWS operation occurs

acceptance.requirement: The disposable environment contains only declared dependencies; versions are recorded.
acceptance.evidence: rehearsal record and clean standard-library environments
acceptance.failure_condition: undeclared dependency is required or environment identity is absent

acceptance.requirement: Every Part 1 requirement maps exactly once to authority, fixture/oracle or justified future proof, failure condition, and claim level.
acceptance.failure_condition: missing, duplicate, incomplete, or extra requirement mapping

acceptance.requirement: Every fixture maps back to at least one stable requirement and contract version.
acceptance.failure_condition: orphan fixture or unfrozen contract version

acceptance.requirement: All mandatory identity, watermark, session, TTL, poison, skew, replay, and crash-boundary cases exist.
acceptance.failure_condition: a mandatory fixture class or named boundary is missing

acceptance.requirement: Equality and one-unit-past cases exist for gap, watermark, TTL, and relevant clock boundaries.
acceptance.evidence: boundary fixture IDs enforced by validator and tests
acceptance.failure_condition: either side of a required exact boundary is absent

acceptance.requirement: Fixture inputs and expectations contain no ambient time, randomness, machine path, or locale dependency.
acceptance.evidence: deterministic corpus, repeated runs, and source review
acceptance.failure_condition: normalized output depends on ambient execution state

acceptance.requirement: The evaluator does not import or invoke the production processor or future Lambda entry path.
acceptance.evidence: AST import validator and clean environment
acceptance.failure_condition: oracle import graph leaves the declared standard-library boundary

acceptance.requirement: Representative expectations are independently hand-derived and reviewed.
acceptance.evidence: literal recovery expectations, stable session digest, and skeptical review
acceptance.failure_condition: goldens are captured from an implementation output without independent derivation

acceptance.requirement: Counts, content, state, effects, checkpoint, and canonical hashes are compared—not merely exit codes.
acceptance.evidence: oracle results, focused unit tests, and manifest digests
acceptance.failure_condition: a gate accepts on process exit without semantic or byte comparison

acceptance.requirement: Two same-environment runs and one clean-environment run produce identical normalized output and hashes.
acceptance.evidence: rehearsal evidence with byte and SHA-256 comparisons
acceptance.failure_condition: any repeated result or manifest differs

acceptance.requirement: Metamorphic properties pass only within the ordering and lateness domains allowed by the contract.
acceptance.failure_condition: a stated invariant exceeds the frozen order-sensitive domain or fails inside it

acceptance.requirement: Every required controlled corruption fails the intended gate.
acceptance.failure_condition: a corruption passes or fails only for an unrelated reason

acceptance.requirement: Missing, malformed, stale, contradictory, or extra evidence fails closed.
acceptance.failure_condition: invalid evidence is accepted

acceptance.requirement: The pristine suite passes immediately after negative controls and leaves a clean worktree.
acceptance.evidence: non-mutating negative tests followed by full pristine gate
acceptance.failure_condition: controls mutate source or pristine rerun fails

acceptance.requirement: No failure is skipped, disabled, relabeled, or converted into expected success.
acceptance.failure_condition: skip, expected failure, continue-on-error, or weakened assertion hides a required failure

acceptance.requirement: The exact local command sequence is reproducible from a clean declared environment.
acceptance.failure_condition: declared commands cannot recreate the result

acceptance.requirement: Every future managed phase has preconditions, stop conditions, rollback or cleanup, resume point, and stale-evidence rules.
acceptance.failure_condition: a future phase lacks a safe decision boundary

acceptance.requirement: Parts 2–5 acceptance criteria are stable, traceable, and preserve claim ceilings.
acceptance.failure_condition: future criteria are incomplete, duplicated, or permit premature promotion

acceptance.requirement: Mandatory semantic contradictions equal zero; future AWS proof obligations remain explicit.
acceptance.failure_condition: unresolved contradiction exists or an AWS obligation disappears

acceptance.requirement: Skeptical review findings are resolved or classified as blocking; none are hidden.
acceptance.failure_condition: finding has no resolution or explicit blocking disposition

acceptance.requirement: Stage 3 evidence is sanitized, deterministic, checksum-bound, and complete.
acceptance.failure_condition: sensitive identifier, nondeterminism, missing artifact, or digest mismatch

acceptance.requirement: Focused Stage 3 and cumulative Stage 1–2 gates pass locally and in CI.
acceptance.failure_condition: any focused or cumulative gate is not successful

acceptance.requirement: Exact reviewed head/base/tree and changed-file scope are rechecked immediately before guarded merge.
acceptance.failure_condition: reviewed identity, ancestry, scope, mergeability, or CI changes

acceptance.requirement: Authority merge main SHA/tree and push CI are independently verified.
acceptance.failure_condition: merged authority identity or push CI cannot be resolved successfully

acceptance.requirement: The separate completion-receipt PR passes exact-head CI, guarded merge, and final-main CI.
acceptance.failure_condition: receipt identity, merge, or final push CI is not successful

acceptance.requirement: The receipt states EVENTPULSE_PART1_COMPLETION_VERIFIED, never whole-project completion.
acceptance.failure_condition: receipt omits the exact Part 1 marker or claims whole-project completion

acceptance.requirement: Managed consumer, AWS recovery, latency, throughput, observed spend, and teardown remain unverified until their later evidence gates pass.
acceptance.evidence: claim-level validator and future acceptance registry
acceptance.failure_condition: any future managed or measured claim is prematurely promoted

dependency_note: AC-27 through AC-29 require immutable observations created only after the authority or receipt merge. Their definitions are frozen here; their results are recorded in the separate completion receipt.
